prompt: If somebody was born on the day the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 was signed, how old would they have been while Albert A. Michelson and Edward W. Morley were performing their Michelson-Morley experiment?
answer: Someone born on **August 13, 1814**, the date the Anglo-Dutch Treaty was signed, would have been **72 years old** during the Michelson–Morley experiment in **April–July 1887**. They would have turned **73 on August 13, 1887**, shortly after the experiment.
